title: OpenAI gelir beklentileri ve finansal güncellemeleri hakkında açıklama yaptı
summary: OpenAI, yıllık gelirinin daha önce öngörülenden 20 milyar dolar daha düşük, yaklaşık 50 milyar dolar seviyesinde olduğunu yatırımcılarıyla paylaştı.
body:
OpenAI'ın yatırımcılarına sunduğu güncel finansal raporlar, şirketin yıllık gelirine dair beklentileri yeniden şekillendirdi. Finansal verilerde yaşanan bu revizyon, daha önce 70 milyar dolar civarında olduğu tahmin edilen yıllık gelirin gerçekte 50 milyar dolar seviyesinde olduğunu ortaya koydu. **OpenAI** tarafından yapılan açıklamaya göre, önceki 70 milyar dolarlık rakam, rakibi Anthropic ile doğrudan kıyaslama yapabilmek amacıyla yatırımcıların kendi analizleri üzerinden türetilen bir projeksiyondan ibaretti.

## Gelir büyümesi ve finansal durum
OpenAI, yatırımcılarına sunduğu bu yeni verilerin yanı sıra şirket performansına dair olumlu göstergeleri de vurguladı. Şirket, üçüncü çeyrekte toplam iş hacminde yüzde 77'lik bir büyüme kaydettiğini, kurumsal taraftaki iş hacminin ise aynı dönemde yüzde 107 oranında artış gösterdiğini belirtti. Şirket yönetimi, Mart ayında tamamlanan 122 milyar dolarlık devasa yatırım turunun ardından finansal olarak güçlü bir konumda olduklarını ifade ediyor.

## Gelecek planları ve halka arz
Finansal verilerin netleşmesiyle birlikte şirketin piyasa üzerindeki baskı da sürüyor. 852 milyar dolarlık değerlemesiyle dikkat çeken OpenAI, Haziran ayında halka arz (IPO) süreci için regülatörlere başvuruda bulunmuştu. Daha önce bu yıl gerçekleşmesi beklenen halka arzın, 2027 yılının başına ertelendiği belirtiliyor. Bu süreçte şirket, yatırımcı talebi doğrultusunda yaklaşık 30 milyar dolarlık yeni bir fon toplama arayışını da sürdürüyor.

**Neden önemli?** OpenAI'ın gelir projeksiyonlarındaki bu düzeltme, yapay zeka sektörüne yönelik devasa yatırımların finansal gerçeklerle nasıl karşılandığını göstermesi açısından kritik görülüyor. Bu durum, piyasa beklentileri ile şirketlerin gerçek performansları arasındaki hassas dengeyi yansıtıyor.

source_texts.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
source_texts.summary: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.
source_texts.text:
A little over a week ago, it was reported that OpenAI’s annualized revenue was approaching $70 billion, a figure that would have made it competitive with Anthropic’s reported run rate. Now, however, the AI lab is said to have told investors that the real revenue is some $20 billion lower than that.
The Financial Times reports that the company has told investors that its annualized revenue is “approaching $50 billion.” The publication also notes that the previous figure of $70 billion was based on information that had previously been shared with investors by OpenAI. That figure was devised via “attempts by OpenAI’s own investors to produce a direct comparison with Anthropic’s annualised revenues,” per the FT.
It’s worth pointing out that OpenAI and Anthropic calculate their annualized revenue differently — with Anthropic counting sales made by its cloud partners. OpenAI doesn’t do this.
TechCrunch reached out to OpenAI for comment.
The issue of OpenAI’s revenue has troubled the company, as it attempts to justify the gargantuan investments being made on its behalf; the AI giant raised $122 billion during a March funding round alone. The company’s leaked 2025 financials earlier this year showed it had made about $13 billion but spent significantly more. OpenAI’s IPO, which was previously rumored to be materializing this year, has been pushed off until early 2027.

source_texts.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
source_texts.summary: OpenAI has told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed.
source_texts.text:
Shares of Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other artificial intelligence names sank lower on Thursday after the market learned more details about OpenAI's revenue.
OpenAI told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed, lower than the the $68 billion figure that was widely reported late last month. A person familiar with the matter said the $68 billion figure included gross revenue from OpenAI's partners, which helps investors make a more direct comparison with its chief rival, Anthropic.
The Financial Times was first to report the $50 billion figure.
OpenAI shared an update about its finances in an investor presentation, said the person, who asked not to be named in order to discuss the numbers. In addition to the $50 billion in annualized revenue, OpenAI touted 77% total run rate growth during its third quarter, as well as 107% run rate growth for its enterprise business during the same period, the person said.
The company is under pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation to investors as it gears up for what is widely expected to be a blockbuster IPO. OpenAI confidentially filed its prospectus with regulators in June, and executives have signaled that the company is eyeing a 2027 debut.
In the interim, OpenAI is engaging in early stage discussions with investors about a potential new funding round. The company could raise around $30 billion, as CNBC previously reported, but that figure could change. The round is being driven by investor demand and no term sheet has been finalized yet.
OpenAI closed a historic $122 billion funding round in March, and CFO Sarah Friar told CNBC last week that it is still "very well capitalized."
